Why AyneraWhy Aynera

More people is not the same as more possibility

Your everyday circle only takes you so far .. dating apps can show you more people than ever, but more profiles do not always create better opportunities

Aynera expands your circle with people you may genuinely want to meet .. and gives you more natural ways to cross paths

Meet your wayMeet your way

Meet directly .. or let something in common bring you together

Some people prefer a direct introduction .. others connect more naturally while doing something they already enjoy

01 / Duos

Duos

A small number of relevant introductions .. with enough context to understand why meeting each other could be worth exploring.

You talk first in a considered way .. so the next step feels clearer when you decide to meet.

Inside Duos→

02 / Squads

Squads

Small social experiences around shared interests, energy and lifestyle .. a more natural way to meet than a formal date.

You join a few people nearby .. so conversation can start without one-to-one pressure.

Inside the appInside the app

Every introduction comes with a reason.

No score, no ranking, no mystery algorithm bragging. You see why you were introduced, what you share, and one clear next step.

  • A small, considered set — never an endless feed
  • Focus pauses discovery only when both people choose it
  • Meet plans stay private unless you share them

Intent, without a splitIntent, without a split

Trust before access

Meet more people without giving up control

Reviewed access, not a guarantee

Aynera reviews access and uses verification to increase confidence around who enters the network .. but no check can guarantee how another person will behave

Get a real read first

Start inside Aynera while you understand someone’s pace, intent and vibe .. your phone number and social handles stay private until you decide to share them

Make the first meet easier to plan safely

For first meetings, Aynera encourages busy public places and recommended venues where available .. you can share meeting details with someone you trust and use simple check in tools

Core safety tools stay free

Why come backWhy come back

Still single next week? Your circle has already changed

New people join .. new introductions become relevant .. new Squads appear

Aynera is designed to feel like a changing social world .. not the same pile of profiles waiting for another swipe

Drops on Saturday .. happens Sunday

Every Saturday, a new surprise Squad gathering appears in your city .. register yourself, then meet on Sunday at a partner place people already know

  • Revealed Saturday — the gathering is Sunday
  • One surprise Squad in every live city each week
  • Partner venues — popular, known public spaces

Building one strong circle first

Delhi, Mumbai and Bangalore first.

If something clicksIf something clicks

When you choose each other, we stop the search

If one connection starts becoming more important, Focus lets both people mutually pause new discovery and give that connection more attention

If you later choose exclusivity, Together removes both of you from discovery .. both states are optional and your relationship does not have to stay inside Aynera

Focus→Together→
